{{recipesummary|category=Egg recipes|servings=8|time=1 hour|difficulty=2}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Southern cuisine|Southern U.S. cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Breakfast|Breakfast Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Cheese|Cheese]]

This is a good dish for [[Cookbook:Breakfast|breakfast]], [[Cookbook:Brunch|brunch]], or late-night snack dish.

==Ingredients==

* 2 strips [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]]
* 24 [[Cookbook:Soda Cracker|soda crackers]] (2-inch squares)
* 6 large [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* ⅛ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 dash of [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|cheddar cheese]], cut into small pieces.
* [[Cookbook:Cooking Spray|Cooking spray]]
* [[Cookbook:Jam|Jam]] or [[Cookbook:jelly|jelly]] (optional)

==Procedure==

# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|350°F]] (~175°C).
# Cut bacon into small pieces and [[Cookbook:Sauté|sauté]] until brown.
# Crush crackers.
# Beat eggs in bowl. 
# Add crackers, milk, salt, and pepper, then cheese to the eggs.
# Spray casserole dish with cooking spray.
# Pour mixture into [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|casserole dish]], and add bacon.
# [[Cookbook:Bake|Bake]] in preheated oven until a knife comes out clean when pie is tested.
# Cut in wedges and serve with jam.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* You can dice, shred, or just cut up the cheese; the smaller the pieces, the more evenly it will mix.
